description: Revert to the 8-layer architecture with 128 head dimension and 128 device batch size, increase the matrix learning rate to 0.065 (which previously yielded the best result of 0.9882) and reintroduce a 2% linear warmup to stabilize the initial phase, aiming to match or beat the current best of 0.9881 by leveraging the higher learning rate's faster convergence while mitigating early instability.
